column1: # What the wasm build replaces in vendor/alchemy (pinned 24b72a32) and why (orchestrator D3). Vendor files are
# never edited or copied: a replaced header is taken over by port/shim/prelude.h (its include guard), a replaced
# C file is left out of the build and our own file takes its place.
# kind: header = shim header (done); file = whole vendor file replaced (todo in G2); asm = vendor assembly routine
# replaced by our C (todo, D6). status: done | todo

column5: Dma_Set is a register-pinned stmia in inline asm; ours stores the three DMA registers and calls Port_DmaWritten
calls ARM routines at fixed IWRAM addresses; wasm calls our C functions (Port_Iwram*)
identity matrix stores are three stmia in inline asm; plain C
smull/orr in inline asm; 64-bit product in C
FIXED_ADDRESS/FIXED_OFFSET: plain constants (identity memory map, D5) instead of MODERN's linked names
__builtin_return_address (a FAKEMATCH test) defined as NULL, which takes the same return
GNU nested functions (clang rejects them): lift to file-scope functions with an explicit context
calls an IWRAM routine as IwramIrqMain + Iwram_CopyWordsOffset (address arithmetic on code)
ARM C calling IWRAM routines by offset from IwramIrqMain (IWRAM_ENTRY)
swi 2/3 (Halt/Stop) and the frame-wait stack switch (mov sp) in inline asm: becomes the fiber yield (D8)
